front: A edição genética com CRISPR levanta dilemas éticos inéditos.
pronunciation: ah eh-jee-SOWNG zheh-NEH-chee-kah kohng KREES-pehr leh-VAHN-tah jee-LEH-mahz EH-chee-kooz ee-NEH-jee-toos.
back: Gene editing with CRISPR raises unprecedented ethical dilemmas.
context: 'Levantar' = to raise (questions, dilemmas). 'Inédito' = unprecedented, never seen before.

front: Editar embriões humanos ainda é proibido na maioria dos países.
pronunciation: eh-jee-TAHR ehm-bree-OYNGZ oo-MAH-nooz ah-EEN-dah EH proy-BEE-doo nah mah-yoh-REE-ah dooz pah-EE-zees.
back: Editing human embryos is still prohibited in most countries.
context: An infinitive phrase as subject ('Editar embriões…') takes a singular verb.

front: Onde fica o limite entre tratar uma doença e aprimorar o ser humano?
pronunciation: OHN-jee FEE-kah oo lee-MEE-chee EHN-tree trah-TAHR OO-mah doh-EHN-sah ee ah-pree-moh-RAHR oo SEHR oo-MAH-noo?
back: Where is the line between treating a disease and enhancing human beings?
context: Core bioethics question. 'Aprimorar' = to enhance, improve. 'O ser humano' = the human being.

front: O ensaio clínico de fase três envolveu trinta mil voluntários.
pronunciation: oo ehn-SAHY-oo KLEE-nee-koo jee FAH-zee TREHZ ehn-vohl-VEH-oo TREEN-tah MEE-oo voh-loon-TAH-ryoos.
back: The phase three clinical trial involved thirty thousand volunteers.
context: 'Ensaio clínico' = clinical trial. Phase 3 tests efficacy on a large population.

front: O estudo foi duplo-cego e controlado por placebo.
pronunciation: oo ehs-TOO-doo FOY DOO-ploo-SEH-goo ee kohn-troh-LAH-doo pohr plah-SEH-boo.
back: The study was double-blind and placebo-controlled.
context: 'Duplo-cego' = neither participants nor researchers know who receives the real treatment.

front: Todos os participantes assinaram o termo de consentimento livre e esclarecido.
pronunciation: TOH-dooz ooz pahr-chee-see-PAHN-cheez ah-see-NAH-rowng oo TEHR-moo jee kohn-sehn-chee-MEHN-too LEE-vree ee ehs-klah-reh-SEE-doo.
back: All participants signed the informed consent form.
context: The 'TCLE' is mandatory in Brazilian research with humans. 'Esclarecido' = informed, enlightened.

front: A vacina demonstrou eficácia de noventa por cento contra casos graves.
pronunciation: ah vah-SEE-nah deh-mohns-TROH eh-fee-KAH-syah jee noh-VEHN-tah pohr SEHN-too KOHN-trah KAH-zooz GRAH-vees.
back: The vaccine showed ninety percent efficacy against severe cases.
context: 'Eficácia' = efficacy (in trials); 'efetividade' = effectiveness (in the real world).

front: Os efeitos colaterais mais comuns foram dor no braço e febre baixa.
pronunciation: ooz eh-FAY-tooz koh-lah-teh-RAHYZ MAHYS koh-MOONGS FOH-rowng DOHR noo BRAH-soo ee FEH-bree BAHY-shah.
back: The most common side effects were arm pain and a low fever.
context: 'Efeitos colaterais' = side effects. 'Febre baixa' = low-grade fever.

front: A Anvisa aprovou o uso emergencial do medicamento.
pronunciation: ah ahn-VEE-zah ah-proh-VOH oo OO-zoo eh-mehr-zhehn-SYOW doo meh-jee-kah-MEHN-too.
back: Anvisa approved the emergency use of the drug.
context: Anvisa is Brazil's health regulatory agency (similar to the FDA). 'Medicamento' = medicine, drug.

front: O Instituto Butantan e a Fiocruz são referências mundiais em produção de vacinas.
pronunciation: oo eens-chee-TOO-too boo-tahn-TAHNG ee ah fee-oh-KROOZ SOWNG rreh-feh-REHN-syahz moon-jee-AHYZ eng proh-doo-SOWNG jee vah-SEE-nahs.
back: The Butantan Institute and Fiocruz are world references in vaccine production.
context: Butantan (São Paulo) and Fiocruz (Rio) are public research institutions. 'Ser referência' = to be a benchmark.

front: O SUS garante atendimento gratuito a toda a população.
pronunciation: oo SOOS gah-RAHN-chee ah-tehn-jee-MEHN-too grah-TOO-ee-too ah TOH-dah ah poh-poo-lah-SOWNG.
back: The SUS guarantees free care to the entire population.
context: Brazil's Unified Health System, created by the 1988 Constitution, is one of the largest public health systems in the world.

front: O Programa Nacional de Imunizações é um dos mais abrangentes do mundo.
pronunciation: oo proh-GRAH-mah nah-syoh-NOW jee ee-moo-nee-zah-SOYNGZ EH oong dooz MAHYZ ah-brahn-ZHEHN-cheez doo MOON-doo.
back: The National Immunization Program is one of the most comprehensive in the world.
context: Created in 1973; its mascot is Zé Gotinha. 'Abrangente' = comprehensive, wide-ranging.

front: A queda da cobertura vacinal preocupa os epidemiologistas.
pronunciation: ah KEH-dah dah koh-behr-TOO-rah vah-see-NOW pree-oh-KOO-pah ooz eh-pee-deh-myoh-loh-ZHEES-tahs.
back: The drop in vaccination coverage worries epidemiologists.
context: 'Cobertura vacinal' = vaccination coverage. 'Preocupar' = to worry (someone).

front: Quando a maioria se vacina, protege também quem não pode se vacinar.
pronunciation: KWAHN-doo ah mah-yoh-REE-ah see vah-SEE-nah, proh-TEH-zhee tahm-BENG KENG NOWNG POH-jee see vah-see-NAHR.
back: When most people get vaccinated, they also protect those who can't be vaccinated.
context: The idea behind herd immunity ('imunidade de rebanho' or 'imunidade coletiva').

front: Em 1904, a vacinação obrigatória provocou a Revolta da Vacina no Rio.
pronunciation: eng MEEL ee noh-veh-SEHN-tooz ee KWAH-troo, ah vah-see-nah-SOWNG oh-bree-gah-TOH-ryah proh-voh-KOH ah rreh-VOHL-tah dah vah-SEE-nah noo RREE-oo.
back: In 1904, compulsory vaccination sparked the Vaccine Revolt in Rio.
context: Riots against Oswaldo Cruz's smallpox campaign, fueled by misinformation and authoritarian methods.

front: A taxa de transmissão caiu depois das medidas de isolamento.
pronunciation: ah TAH-shah jee trahnz-mee-SOWNG kah-EE-oo deh-POYZ dahz meh-JEE-dahz jee ee-zoh-lah-MEHN-too.
back: The transmission rate fell after the isolation measures.
context: 'Taxa' = rate (also fee). 'Isolamento' = isolation; 'quarentena' = quarantine.

front: O aumento de casos de dengue está ligado às chuvas e ao calor.
pronunciation: oo ow-MEHN-too jee KAH-zooz jee DEHN-gee ehs-TAH lee-GAH-doo AHS SHOO-vahz ee ah-oo kah-LOHR.
back: The rise in dengue cases is linked to the rains and the heat.
context: Dengue is transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito. 'Estar ligado a' = to be linked to.

front: Não deixe água parada em vasos e pneus: é lá que o mosquito se reproduz.
pronunciation: NOWNG DAY-shee AH-gwah pah-RAH-dah eng VAH-zooz ee PNEH-oos: EH LAH keh oo mohs-KEE-too see rreh-proh-DOOS.
back: Don't leave standing water in pots and tires: that's where the mosquito breeds.
context: Classic Brazilian public health campaign message. 'Água parada' = standing water.

front: Saneamento básico é a política de saúde mais eficaz que existe.
pronunciation: sah-nee-ah-MEHN-too BAH-zee-koo EH ah poh-LEE-chee-kah jee sah-OO-jee MAHYZ eh-fee-KAHS keh eh-ZEES-chee.
back: Basic sanitation is the most effective health policy there is.
context: 'Saneamento básico' = water supply and sewage. Millions of Brazilians still lack sewage collection.

front: Correlação não basta: precisamos de evidências de causalidade.
pronunciation: koh-rreh-lah-SOWNG NOWNG BAHS-tah: preh-see-ZAH-mooz jee eh-vee-DEHN-syahz jee kow-zah-lee-DAH-jee.
back: Correlation isn't enough: we need evidence of causation.
context: 'Não basta' = it isn't enough. A key idea in epidemiology.

front: A revisão sistemática reuniu dados de quarenta estudos.
pronunciation: ah rreh-vee-ZOWNG sees-teh-MAH-chee-kah rreh-oo-NEE-oo DAH-dooz jee kwah-REHN-tah ehs-TOO-doos.
back: The systematic review pooled data from forty studies.
context: 'Revisão sistemática' and 'metanálise' are at the top of the evidence pyramid. 'Reunir' = to gather, pool.

front: O artigo foi retratado após a descoberta de dados manipulados.
pronunciation: oo ahr-CHEE-goo FOY rreh-trah-TAH-doo ah-POHZ ah jehs-koh-BEHR-tah jee DAH-dooz mah-nee-poo-LAH-doos.
back: The paper was retracted after manipulated data was discovered.
context: 'Retratar' here = to retract (a publication); it also means to portray.

front: A desinformação sobre saúde se espalha mais rápido do que os fatos.
pronunciation: ah jee-zeen-fohr-mah-SOWNG SOH-bree sah-OO-jee see ehs-PAH-lyah MAHYS RRAH-pee-doo doo keh ooz FAH-toos.
back: Health misinformation spreads faster than the facts.
context: 'Espalhar-se' = to spread. 'Mais rápido do que' = faster than.

front: O médico explicou o diagnóstico em linguagem acessível.
pronunciation: oo MEH-jee-koo ehs-plee-KOH oo jee-ahg-NOHS-chee-koo eng leen-GWAH-zheng ah-seh-SEE-vehl.
back: The doctor explained the diagnosis in accessible language.
context: 'Linguagem acessível' = plain language. Good science communication avoids jargon ('jargão').

front: Os resultados ainda são preliminares e precisam ser replicados.
pronunciation: ooz rreh-zool-TAH-dooz ah-EEN-dah SOWNG preh-lee-mee-NAH-reez ee preh-SEE-zowng SEHR rreh-plee-KAH-doos.
back: The results are still preliminary and need to be replicated.
context: Careful scientific hedging. 'Replicar' = to replicate (a study).

front: O estudo ainda não foi revisado por pares, então convém cautela.
pronunciation: oo ehs-TOO-doo ah-EEN-dah NOWNG FOY rreh-vee-ZAH-doo pohr PAH-reez, ehn-TOWNG kohn-VENG kow-TEH-lah.
back: The study hasn't been peer-reviewed yet, so caution is advisable.
context: 'Convém' (from 'convir') = it's advisable. A 'preprint' is an article not yet peer-reviewed.

front: A doença é assintomática na maioria dos casos.
pronunciation: ah doh-EHN-sah EH ah-seen-toh-MAH-chee-kah nah mah-yoh-REE-ah dooz KAH-zoos.
back: The disease is asymptomatic in most cases.
context: 'Assintomático' = without symptoms. 'Sintoma' = symptom.

front: O paciente foi internado na UTI com insuficiência respiratória.
pronunciation: oo pah-see-EHN-chee FOY een-tehr-NAH-doo nah oo-teh-EE kohng een-soo-fee-see-EHN-syah rrehs-pee-rah-TOH-ryah.
back: The patient was admitted to the ICU with respiratory failure.
context: 'UTI' (Unidade de Terapia Intensiva) = ICU. 'Ser internado' = to be admitted to hospital.

front: A telemedicina ampliou o acesso a especialistas no interior.
pronunciation: ah teh-leh-meh-jee-SEE-nah ahm-plee-OH oo ah-SEH-soo ah ehs-peh-syah-LEES-tahz noo een-teh-ree-OHR.
back: Telemedicine expanded access to specialists in the countryside.
context: 'O interior' = inland/rural areas away from big cities (not 'interior').

front: Faltam médicos em regiões remotas da Amazônia.
pronunciation: FAHL-towng MEH-jee-kooz eng rreh-zhee-OYNGZ rreh-MOH-tahz dah ah-mah-ZOH-nyah.
back: There's a shortage of doctors in remote regions of the Amazon.
context: 'Faltar' agrees with what is missing: 'faltam médicos' (plural).

front: É ético usar inteligência artificial para decidir quem recebe um transplante?
pronunciation: EH EH-chee-koo oo-ZAHR een-teh-lee-ZHEHN-syah ahr-chee-fee-SYOW PAH-rah deh-see-JEER KENG rreh-SEH-bee oong trahns-PLAHN-chee?
back: Is it ethical to use artificial intelligence to decide who receives a transplant?
context: Typical bioethics debate question. Brazil has one of the largest public transplant programs in the world.

front: A doação de órgãos depende da autorização da família.
pronunciation: ah doh-ah-SOWNG jee OHR-gowngz deh-PEHN-jee dah ow-toh-ree-zah-SOWNG dah fah-MEE-lyah.
back: Organ donation depends on the family's authorization.
context: In Brazil, the family must consent, so it's important to tell relatives your wishes.

front: A eutanásia é proibida no Brasil, mas a ortotanásia é aceita.
pronunciation: ah eh-oo-tah-NAH-zyah EH proy-BEE-dah noo brah-ZEE-oo, mahz ah ohr-toh-tah-NAH-zyah EH ah-SAY-tah.
back: Euthanasia is prohibited in Brazil, but orthothanasia is accepted.
context: 'Ortotanásia' = allowing a natural death without futile life-prolonging treatment, supported by medical ethics rules.

front: Os cuidados paliativos priorizam a qualidade de vida do paciente.
pronunciation: ooz kwee-DAH-dooz pah-lee-ah-CHEE-vooz pree-oh-REE-zowng ah kwah-lee-DAH-jee jee VEE-dah doo pah-see-EHN-chee.
back: Palliative care prioritizes the patient's quality of life.
context: 'Cuidados paliativos' = palliative care. 'Priorizar' = to prioritize.

front: A resistência a antibióticos é uma ameaça silenciosa.
pronunciation: ah rreh-zees-TEHN-syah ah ahn-chee-bee-OH-chee-kooz EH OO-mah ah-meh-AH-sah see-lehn-SYOH-zah.
back: Antibiotic resistance is a silent threat.
context: In Brazil, antibiotics require a prescription that the pharmacy keeps ('retenção de receita').

front: Não se automedique: consulte um profissional de saúde.
pronunciation: NOWNG see ow-toh-meh-JEE-kee: kohn-SOOL-chee oong proh-fee-syoh-NOW jee sah-OO-jee.
back: Don't self-medicate: consult a health professional.
context: A warning found on Brazilian drug ads ('Ao persistirem os sintomas, um médico deverá ser consultado').

front: A pesquisa com células-tronco abre caminho para novas terapias.
pronunciation: ah pehs-KEE-zah kohng SEH-loo-lahs-TROHN-koo AH-bree kah-MEE-nyoo PAH-rah NOH-vahs teh-rah-PEE-ahs.
back: Stem cell research is opening the way to new therapies.
context: 'Célula-tronco' (trunk cell) = stem cell; plural 'células-tronco'.

front: O financiamento público da ciência sofreu cortes drásticos.
pronunciation: oo fee-nahn-syah-MEHN-too POO-blee-koo dah see-EHN-syah soh-FREH-oo KOHR-cheez DRAHS-chee-koos.
back: Public funding for science suffered drastic cuts.
context: 'Sofrer cortes' = to suffer cuts. A recurring topic in Brazilian universities.

front: Muitos pesquisadores deixaram o país em busca de melhores condições.
pronunciation: MOOY-tooz pehs-kee-zah-DOH-reez day-SHAH-rowng oo pah-EES eng BOOS-kah jee meh-LYOH-reez kohn-jee-SOYNGS.
back: Many researchers left the country in search of better conditions.
context: Known as 'fuga de cérebros' (brain drain). 'Em busca de' = in search of.

front: A pandemia expôs as desigualdades no acesso à saúde.
pronunciation: ah pahn-deh-MEE-ah ehs-POHZ ahz jee-zee-gwahl-DAH-jeez noo ah-SEH-soo AH sah-OO-jee.
back: The pandemic exposed inequalities in access to healthcare.
context: 'Expor' (conjugated like 'pôr') = to expose: expôs, expuseram. Note the crase in 'acesso à saúde'.

front: A saúde mental também é uma questão de saúde pública.
pronunciation: ah sah-OO-jee mehn-TAHL tahm-BENG EH OO-mah kehs-TOWNG jee sah-OO-jee POO-blee-kah.
back: Mental health is also a public health issue.
context: 'Questão' = issue, matter. The SUS has a mental health network called CAPS.

front: O uso de animais em pesquisas é regulamentado por lei.
pronunciation: oo OO-zoo jee ah-nee-MAHYZ eng pehs-KEE-zahz EH rreh-goo-lah-mehn-TAH-doo pohr LAY.
back: The use of animals in research is regulated by law.
context: 'Regulamentar' = to regulate. Committees (CEUAs) must approve every animal study.

front: Os dados genéticos dos pacientes são protegidos pela LGPD.
pronunciation: ooz DAH-dooz zheh-NEH-chee-kooz dooz pah-see-EHN-cheez SOWNG proh-teh-ZHEE-dooz PEH-lah eh-lee-zheh-peh-DEH.
back: Patients' genetic data is protected by the LGPD.
context: The LGPD is Brazil's data protection law (similar to the GDPR). Health data is classified as sensitive.

front: Prevenir continua sendo mais barato do que remediar.
pronunciation: preh-veh-NEER kohn-chee-NOO-ah SEHN-doo MAHYZ bah-RAH-too doo keh rreh-meh-jee-AHR.
back: Prevention is still cheaper than cure.
context: Based on the saying 'É melhor prevenir do que remediar'. 'Continuar sendo' = to still be.

front: A ciência não oferece certezas absolutas, mas o melhor conhecimento disponível.
pronunciation: ah see-EHN-syah NOWNG oh-feh-REH-see sehr-TEH-zahz ahb-soh-LOO-tahs, mahz oo meh-LYOHR koh-nyeh-see-MEHN-too jees-poh-NEE-vehl.
back: Science doesn't offer absolute certainties, but the best knowledge available.
context: A useful closing line in debates about science denial ('negacionismo').
